sections.Profile:
Big Foot is a rare pinball machine produced by Bally Manufacturing Co. in 1976. Only two units were ever created, making it one of the most elusive machines from that era. It features a widebody cabinet with mechanical reels for scoring and artwork by Dick White. The game was initially part of an experimental project involving oversized pinball machines but was never put into mass production due to practical challenges, such as mechanical issues caused by vibrations. Bally ultimately canceled the project after testing.
